description: Single source of truth for the Siren starter tag list. Read at runtime by both the C++ plugin (via rack::asset::plugin) and the Python training pipeline (via scripts/siren-tag-model/export_tag_manifest.py). Edit THIS file when adding/removing/renaming tags. Keep the entries sorted by 'name'.

tags.name: Acoustic
tags.description: Acoustic instrument character: natural harmonics with exponential decay. Guitar, piano, marimba.

tags.name: Atmospheric
tags.description: Slowly evolving ambient texture. Pads, washes, drones with movement and space.

tags.name: Bass
tags.description: Fills the low end of a patch. Sub- or bass-register sustained or rhythmic material.

tags.name: Clap
tags.description: Clap sound: layered noise bursts with mid-frequency character.

tags.name: Cymbal
tags.description: Cymbal or crash: high-frequency metallic noise with longer decay.

tags.name: Drone
tags.description: Sustained, slowly evolving pitch. A held note or pad-like bed.

tags.name: Drums
tags.description: Full drum pattern or kit loop: combination of kick, snare, and hi-hat.

tags.name: FX
tags.description: Special effect: sweeps, risers, impacts, designed sounds.

tags.name: Glitch
tags.description: Glitchy, stuttering, or fragmented audio: random bursts, artifacts, stutter edits.

tags.name: HiHat
tags.description: Hi-hat: short metallic noise burst, high-frequency transient.

tags.name: Kick
tags.description: Kick drum: low-frequency transient with punchy bass content.

tags.name: Lead
tags.description: Carries the melody. Sits on top of the mix, mid/high register, often rhythmic.

tags.name: Loop
tags.description: Cyclical material that loops cleanly — drum loop, melodic phrase, arp.

tags.name: Nature
tags.description: Environmental or nature recording: room tone, wind, rain, outdoor ambience.

tags.name: Noise
tags.description: Broadband noise without a clear tonal component. Wind, hiss, static.

tags.name: One-Shot
tags.description: Single transient event with a defined start and end. Snare hit, stab, pluck.

tags.name: Snare
tags.description: Snare drum: mid-frequency transient with noise component and sharp attack.

tags.name: Vocal
tags.description: Vocal or vocal-like material: sung voice, formant tones, vowel-like resonances.
